description: This file defines the authentication context and provider for a React application, including user management, token handling, and authentication functions such as login, register, and logout.
external_files: react's createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, ReactNode

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom React hook to access authentication context within components.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component that provides authentication state and functions to its children components.

methods.name: parseJwt
methods.description: Parses a JWT token to extract user information, specifically the email ('sub' claim).

methods.name: login
methods.description: Function to authenticate user via backend API, store token, and update user state.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Function to register a new user via backend API, store token, and update user state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing tokens and user state.
